title: Levi's 501
blurb: The button-fly blue jean patented in the 1870s for miners, and the template for almost every pair of jeans since.

title: Aran jumper
blurb: A thick cream wool sweater from Ireland's Aran Islands, covered in cable stitches said to bring fishermen luck.

title: Imogene + Willie
about: Blue jeans made in Nashville, Tennessee
blurb: Imogene + Willie set up shop in Nashville in 2009 on a quest to make the perfect pair of jeans, and makes them in the USA.

title: Tellason
about: Raw selvedge denim cut and sewn in San Francisco
blurb: Tellason has made raw selvedge denim jeans and jackets in San Francisco since 2009: classic American workwear built to last and to fade well.

title: Freenote Cloth
about: Menswear cut, sewn and finished in California
blurb: Freenote makes a classic menswear collection manufactured only in the United States; every piece is cut, sewn and finished in California.

title: Left Field NYC
about: Durable menswear made in the USA
blurb: Left Field NYC makes durable men's clothing, from denim jeans and uniform chinos to tees, cut and sewn in the USA.

title: Christy Dawn
blurb: Christy Dawn makes clothing around a commitment to regeneration, building what it calls reciprocal relationships that heal community and the earth. Its store is in Los Angeles.

title: Dehen 1920
about: Wool sweaters and outerwear from Portland, Oregon
blurb: A family-owned company that has made wool sweaters, shirts and outerwear in Portland, Oregon, since 1920.

title: Okhai
about: Hand-embroidered clothing by rural Indian artisans
blurb: Okhai sells handcrafted apparel and lifestyle pieces made by rural artisans from across India, from hand-embroidered kurtas to dresses.

title: 11.11 / eleven eleven
about: Slow-made clothing with artisans across India
blurb: A designer label making small batches of slow-made clothing with groups of artisans across India, working with indigenous fibres such as Ponduru red cotton.

title: Doodlage
blurb: An eco-fashion label making upcycled, recycled and zero-waste clothing, made to order with fair-wage production, from its studio in Delhi.

title: Abraham & Thakore
blurb: Luxury Indian fashion that blends handloom textiles with modern minimalism: kurtas, saris, shirts and accessories.

title: Raw Mango
about: Saris and garments drawn from Indian cultures
blurb: Raw Mango makes saris and garments that draw on the colours, philosophies and cultures of India.
